mapper.sql: FROM restaurants r LEFT JOIN restaurant_categories c ON c.code = r.category_code LEFT JOIN restaurant_review_statistics s ON s.restaurant_id = r.id

when.test: _parameter.containsKey('query') and query.latitude != null and query.longitude != null

choose.when: CASE WHEN r.needs_location = 0 AND r.latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND r.longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 THEN 6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.latitude - #{query.latitude}) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(#{query.latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(r.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(r.longitude - #{query.longitude}) / 2), 2))))) ELSE NULL END

mapper.sql:
r.id, r.search_projection_version, r.name, r.category_code, r.restaurant_type, r.supports_dine_in, r.supports_delivery, c.name AS category_name, r.price_per_person, r.price_kind, r.address, r.latitude, r.longitude, r.needs_location, r.business_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, COALESCE(s.review_count, 0) AS review_count, COALESCE(s.participant_count, 0) AS participant_count,
ROUND(CAST(s.overall_score_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0), 1) AS score, ROUND(CAST(s.recommend_count AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0), 3) AS recommend_rate, CAST(s.taste_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS taste, CAST(s.value_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS value, CAST(s.service_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS service, CAST(s.ambience_sum AS DECIMAL(40,20)) / NULLIF(s.participant_count, 0) AS ambience, () / 1000 AS distance_km
mapper.select: SELECT code, name, sort_order, enabled FROM restaurant_categories ORDER BY sort_order, code

SELECT
WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
r.price_per_person IS NULL, r.price_per_person, distance_km IS NULL, distance_km, recommend_rate IS NULL, recommend_rate DESC, review_count DESC, score IS NULL, score DESC,
r.name, r.id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM restaurant_search_outbox o JOIN restaurants r ON r.id=o.restaurant_id AND r.search_projection_version=o.projection_version WHERE o.status IN ('PENDING','FAILED') LIMIT 1)

SELECT t.restaurant_id, t.tag, t.position FROM restaurant_tags t JOIN restaurants r ON r.id = t.restaurant_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.restaurant_id IN #{id} ORDER BY t.restaurant_id, t.position
